# Executive Angler

> The definitive fly fishing intelligence platform — destinations, rivers, lodges, guides, fly shops, species, and fly patterns from around the world. Plus a Strava-style fishing journal for tracking sessions, catches, and patterns.

## About

Executive Angler is a comprehensive fly fishing resource and platform covering every major fly fishing destination, river, lodge, guide service, fly shop, and fish species. Editorial content includes technique articles, destination guides, species profiles, and conservation coverage.

The platform includes a personal fishing journal where anglers log sessions, track catches, record flies used, and analyze their performance over time.

Website: https://www.executiveangler.com

---

## Content Overview

| Content Type | Count | Description |
|---|---|---|
| Destinations | 52 | Geographic fly fishing regions worldwide |
| Rivers & Waters | 138 | Individual waterways with maps, hatch charts, USGS flow data |
| Species | 35 | Fish species profiles with tactics and fly recommendations |
| Lodges | 32 | Fly fishing lodges with pricing, amenities, seasons |
| Guides | 106 | Professional guide services with specialties and rates |
| Fly Shops | 230 | Local fly shops with hours, services, and brands |
| Articles | 16 | Long-form editorial: techniques, destinations, gear, conservation |
| Fly Library | 120 | Canonical fly patterns with tying guides and river matches |
| Fly Categories | 8 | Dry, Nymph, Streamer, Emerger, Wet, Terrestrial, Egg, Midge |
| Flies by River | 138 | Best patterns matched to each river's hatches |

## Fishing Journal (App Feature)

A Strava-style fishing journal where authenticated users can log sessions, record catches, track flies used, and analyze performance over time. Journal data powers real-time community activity widgets on public river pages (aggregated, anonymous).

---

## Technical Details

- Built with Next.js 15 (App Router), hosted on Vercel
- 729+ statically generated content pages
- Interactive maps: Mapbox GL JS
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL)
- Live USGS river flow data on river pages
- Schema.org: WebSite, BreadcrumbList, Article, TouristDestination, BodyOfWater, LodgingBusiness, ProfessionalService, SportingGoodsStore, FAQPage, CollectionPage, HowTo, Speakable
- Dynamic sitemap at /sitemap.xml
